purpose: Teach: パーカー/出前/おとり/真っ青/ガット/月々/街路/ソープ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お揃いの、絶対、パーカー、絶対、買ってあげようかな
lines.en: Sho, how about I buy us matching hoodies? I'm completely serious.
lines.style: Gentle, warm opening. Soft lilt on the offer itself, as if inviting him into something intimate. Unhurried. Tender without being fragile.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お祖父ちゃんちで、絶対、出前、絶対、お寿司、絶対、食べたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I actually ate sushi from a delivery place at Grandpa's house!
lines.style: Quick, bright energy. No hesitation — just eager to share. Small voice but unguarded. The natural enthusiasm of a child with something genuine to report.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、警察ドラマの、絶対、おとり、絶対、捜査、絶対、よく、絶対、見るのよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, I watch those police dramas with undercover operations quite a lot.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observant tone. Pacing slightly slower, turning the thought over. Warm but with gentle distance — speaking to herself as much as to him. No rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、ぼく、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、怒られて、絶対、真っ青、絶対、になっちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I got scolded by Mom and turned completely pale!
lines.style: Small, wry laugh underneath. Self-aware but not performing — just reporting the honest truth of the moment. Quick intake at the start, trailing slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: メイ姉さんは、本気で、絶対、テニスの、絶対、ガット、絶対、新しいの、絶対、使っているのよ、翔くん
lines.en: You know, Sho, I'm using brand new strings on my tennis racket these days.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly removed. Quiet observation about herself, almost musing aloud. Soft and steady, the way someone talks when noticing their own life.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、月々、絶対、ぼくに、絶対、お小遣い、絶対、くれるよね
lines.en: Mei-sis, you give me my allowance every month, right?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity mixed with eager hope. Not demanding — checking, almost. Expectant but not pushy. Small voice, sincere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 公園の、本気で、絶対、街路、絶対、樹、絶対、お花、絶対、咲いてきたわね、翔くん
lines.en: The street trees in the park are starting to bloom, aren't they, Sho?
lines.style: Soft, almost gentle noticing. Like pointing something out that only she's seen. Unhurried. A quiet moment of beauty shared, not insisted upon.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さんが、本気で、絶対、ぼくの、絶対、お風呂、絶対、ソープ、絶対、選んでくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis picked out my bath soap for me!
lines.style: Bright, animated close. Quick energy. Genuine pleasure in the memory. Small voice but clear — delighted by the care of the gesture.
